razonamiento: All components from the visual diagram and narration were mapped directly to the catalog. UserCompanyDataStream represents client/hospital data streams sending medical images to S3, while UserCompanyAgent represents pathologists interacting with the Kubernetes product on EKS. FSx provides high-performance data access to SageMaker, with IAM handling security and permissions between them. Two separate lines from S3 to EKS correspond to initial image retrieval for visualization and retrieving trained model results from SageMaker exports.
nombre: Medical Imaging and AI Platform with EKS and SageMaker
